summary.text: Matthew Shepherd is serving his eighth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 97, which includes El Dorado and portions of Union County.

paragraphs.text: He was Speaker of the House from June 2018 to January 2025, the longest-serving Speaker in the chamber's history according to the House, and practices law at Shepherd & Shepherd, P.A. in El Dorado.
Born and raised in El Dorado, he earned a B.A. from Ouachita Baptist University in 1998 and a J.D. from the University of Arkansas School of Law in 2001.
